sar.narrative: Customer C12382 (card C12382-K1) conducted a suspicious in-person transaction (ID 3514030) for $77.07 on 2016-12-04, flagged with a risk score of 0.61 for out-of-region use (product W). The transaction occurred outside the customer's primary region 204.0, deviating from the card's historical activity of 422 transactions averaging $115.60 since 2016-07-06. This pattern matches three prior confirmed fraud cases on the same card: CC-1066 ($170.98 exposure), CC-2964 ($171.08 exposure), and CC-3587 ($49.09 exposure), all involving out-of-region use reported as unrecognized by the cardholder. A fourth case, CC-1673 ($199.98 exposure), involved card-not-present fraud on a new device, further indicating compromise. The card's recent transaction history shows variable amounts, but the out-of-region in-person purchase is inconsistent with the customer's typical spending geography. Based on the recurring fraud pattern and deviation from normal behavior, the transaction was escalated: a case was auto-created (HHG-001), a Level 2 report filed, and the card blocked at Level 1. No connected devices were identified in this event. The activity is considered suspicious due to the repeated confirmed fraud on this card and the geographic anomaly.
